claims.quote: The destroyer swung to the southward, showing her stern to the battle-ship, and increasing her speed as the engine-room staff nursed the oil feed and the turbines.
claims.description: A navy destroyer is driven by oil-fired turbines at very high speed.

claims.quote: all night they charged along at forty knots, with lights extinguished
claims.description: A warship cruises sustained at forty knots.

claims.quote: Casey and Munson, the two wireless operators, would attend to their department
claims.description: Naval vessels carry wireless radio operators who monitor coast and ship traffic.

claims.quote: There is not a craft in the world that can catch her
claims.description: The stolen destroyer is faster than any vessel that might pursue it.

claims.quote: Every nation in the world would send its cruisers after them, and no civilized country would receive them.
claims.description: Escaped sailors who steal a warship become international pirates hunted by every navy.

claims.quote: But you will not reach the coast. You will be hunted down and caught before then.
claims.description: A prediction that the mutineers will be caught before reaching Africa.
